$comment: Every outcome a payment can land in. Note 'processing' and 'pending' are NOT success — that distinction is the whole point of this component.

processing.title: Sending your payment
processing.description: Do not close the app. This usually takes a few seconds.

success.title: Payment completed
success.description: The money has reached Alex Smith.

pending.title: Payment submitted
pending.description: Your bank is still processing this transfer. We will notify you when it settles.

declined.title: Payment declined
declined.description: Your bank declined this payment. No money has left your account.

failed.title: We could not send this payment
failed.description: Something went wrong on our side. You have not been charged.

reversed.title: Payment reversed
reversed.description: The recipient's bank returned this transfer. The money is back in your account.
